basic_details.short_information: Security Printing and Minting Corporation of India Ltd. (SPMCIL), a Mini-Ratna Category-I Central Public Sector Enterprise wholly owned by the Government of India, has released Advertisement No. 02/2026 for recruitment to 24 posts of Deputy Manager (IT) – Application Developer and Assistant Manager across HR, Finance & Accounts, Materials Management, IT, Official Language, and Safety disciplines. Online applications open on 25 July 2026 and close on 24 August 2026. how_to_apply: Visit the official SPMCIL website, www.spmcil.com, click on the "Career" link, and select "APPLY ONLINE" against Advertisement No. 02/2026.

Before filling the application, keep ready: a valid Email ID, Mobile Number, and Aadhaar; a recent passport-size photograph (not older than 3 weeks); scanned Signature/Thumb Impression/handwritten declaration; and your educational and category certificates.
Step-I – Verify Email ID & Mobile Number: Enter your Email ID and Mobile Number, click "Send OTP," and verify both OTPs.
Step-II – Personal Details: Enter all personal information (name, date of birth, gender, category, nationality) exactly as per official records. These details cannot be modified once submitted.
Step-III – Qualification Details: Fill in your qualification details carefully and re-verify before final submission.
Step-IV – Upload Documents: Upload all required documents in the prescribed format and size (see below).

Step-V – Application Fee Payment: Pay the applicable fee online via Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. After submitting payment details, wait for confirmation from the server - do not press the back or refresh button, to avoid a double charge.

After successful payment, you can download or print your complete application form with payment details. Applications can be submitted online only between 25.07.2026 and 24.08.2026 - no other mode of application will be accepted, and once submitted, an application cannot be withdrawn.

content_sections.heading: SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates should ensure they meet all eligibility criteria before applying - eligibility is verified against original documents only after qualifying the online exam, and admission to further stages is purely provisional until then.

rows.qualification_required: 1st Class Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Information Technology/Electronics & Communication Engineering with min. 60% marks or equivalent CGPA, plus minimum 3 years' post-qualification experience as an Officer/Executive in a PSU/Government/reputed private company (turnover above Rs. 50 crore), with experience in C#/Java/JavaScript/ASP.NET/PHP.

1st Class Full Time Master's Degree in PM & IR/MSW/MBA with HR elective, or a 1st class two-year full-time Post Graduate Diploma in Management with HR elective (equivalent to MBA), from a recognized University/Management Institute.
Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) degree along with CA/ICWA.

1st Class Full Time Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Pulp & Paper Technology/Electronics/Printing Technology, plus a two-year Post Graduate degree/diploma/MBA in Materials Management/Stores Management/Purchase/Operations Management/Supply Chain/Logistics Management.
1st Class Full Time MCA, or 1st class B.Tech (Computer Engineering/IT).

1st Class Master's Degree in Hindi or English with the other language as a subject at Graduation level, plus 2 years' translation experience (Hindi to English and/or vice versa). Knowledge of Sanskrit/other Indian languages and computer proficiency in Hindi is desirable.

A recognized Engineering/Technology degree with 2+ years' supervisory factory experience, or a Physics/Chemistry degree with 6+ years' supervisory factory experience, or an Engineering/Technology diploma with 6+ years' supervisory factory experience, or a degree/diploma with 6+ years in accident-prevention training/education/consultancy/research - plus a recognized degree or diploma in Industrial Safety.

content_sections.heading: SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee and intimation charges are inclusive of GST and must be paid online only, via Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. Any bank transaction charge is borne by the applicant. Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other application, including in case of multiple applications by the same candidate.

content_sections.heading: SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection comprises an Online Test (75% weightage) and an Interview (25% weightage). The test is bilingual (Hindi & English), except the English Language section, with a composite duration of 120 minutes. For the post of Assistant Manager (OL), the Professional Knowledge section will be in Hindi and/or English, as applicable to each question. There is a penalty of 1/4th of the marks assigned to a question for every wrong answer. The online examination may be conducted at centres in Delhi & NCR, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, or Bhopal. No request for change of centre, venue, date, or session will be entertained. Minimum qualifying marks in the online exam to be shortlisted for interview: Candidates are shortlisted for interview in the ratio of 1:4 against notified vacancies, category-wise, based on merit in the online exam. content_sections.heading: SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 Admit Card
content_sections.text: Admit cards will be available for download only from www.spmcil.com using the Application Number and Password - no admit card will be sent by post. Candidates must appear at the exam centre with the original Admit Card, an original valid photo ID (PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar with photo, or similar - a Ration Card or Learner's Driving Licence is not accepted), and a photocopy of that ID. The name on the Admit Card must exactly match the name on the photo ID; candidates who have changed their name must carry the original Gazette notification, marriage certificate, or affidavit.

content_sections.heading: SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 Bond Requirement
content_sections.text: New recruits at the E-1 and E-2 levels are required to execute a bond of Rs. 3,00,000 (Rupees Three Lakhs) to serve the Company for a minimum period of three years.

content_sections.heading: SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 Reservation for PwBD Candidates
content_sections.text: As per Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment Notification No. 38-16/2020-DD-III dated 4 January 2021, specific benchmark-disability sub-categories are identified as suitable for each post (except Assistant Manager – Safety, which is not identified for PwBD). Visually impaired candidates, or candidates whose writing speed is permanently affected, may use a scribe arranged at their own cost, subject to eligibility conditions, and are entitled to 20 minutes of compensatory time per hour of examination.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SPMCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 24 vacancies across Deputy Manager (IT) – Application Developer and six Assistant Manager disciplines: HR, F&A, MM, IT, OL, and Safety.

faq.question: Q2. When can I apply online for SPMCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online applications can be submitted from 25 July 2026 to 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SPMCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 1000 (Examination Fee) for General, EWS, and OBC candidates (including Ex-servicemen), and Rs. 200 (Intimation Charges) for SC, ST, and PwBD candidates. Both are non-refundable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SPMCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 35 years for Deputy Manager (IT) and 30 years for all Assistant Manager posts, as on 24 August 2026, with relaxation for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, and Ex-servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for SPMCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an Online Test (75% weightage) and an Interview (25% weightage), with category-wise minimum qualifying marks at both stages.

faq.question: Q6. Is there negative marking in the SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 online exam?
faq.answer: Yes, 1/4th of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for every wrong answer.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a service bond for SPMCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, new recruits at the E-1 and E-2 level must execute a bond of Rs. 3 lakh to serve the company for a minimum of three years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the educational qualification for SPMCIL Assistant Manager (F&A)?
faq.answer: A Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) degree along with CA or ICWA.
